prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption:
A group of young adults gathers casually against a modern, light gray concrete wall adorned with colorful, graphic illustrations and text related to technology, music, and a conference. The wall features circular diagrams, lines, and icons in shades of blue, green, and teal, with bold text such as “SNF Nostos Conference,” “Music,” and “Run,” giving the scene a contemporary, tech-inspired atmosphere. 

The group is diverse in appearance and dress, each person expressing individuality through vibrant, retro-inspired clothing. On the left, a man with curly hair and a beard, wearing a teal long-sleeve shirt and beige pants, leans against the wall, engaged in animated conversation with a woman in a light, earth-toned dress and a loose bun. Nearby, two people sit on the ground: one in a pink headscarf and blue overalls, playfully interacting with a friend in a striped shirt and shorts, both exuding a sense of youthful energy and camaraderie. 

To the right, a man in a green and white striped shirt and dark shorts stands with a relaxed posture, while a woman in a pink top and white skirt, her hair in pigtails, stands beside him, both looking off to the side. The group’s body language is informal and lively, suggesting friendship and shared excitement.

The color palette is fresh and summery, dominated by soft pastels and pops of saturated color in the clothing and wall graphics. Lighting is natural and even, evoking a bright, midday ambiance. The composition is wide and balanced, with the figures spaced along the wall, creating a sense of depth and narrative connection. The overall style is cinematic and contemporary, with a slight retro flair, reminiscent of a coming-of-age film or a vibrant youth culture advertisement. The camera angle is straight-on at eye level, emphasizing the communal, approachable mood of the scene.
